proposals.title: Isotonic Calibration via PurgedKFold
proposals.source: sklearn calibration docs + MetaTrader 5 ML Blueprint (2025)
proposals.technique: Fit isotonic regression on OOF predictions using purged cross-validation to respect NBA temporal ordering. CalibratedClassifierCV(method='isotonic') with PurgedKFold splitter.
proposals.implementation: Wrap XGBoost/CatBoost ensemble with CalibratedClassifierCV(method='isotonic') using PurgedKFold from mlfinlab. Critical: avoid random hold-out calibration which leaks info in sports data.
proposals.why: Current 0.22085 likely has systematic miscalibration. Isotonic is non-parametric and captures model's actual probability distortion without assuming shape.

proposals.title: Calibration-First Model Selection (direct Brier optimization in CV)
proposals.technique: Optimize ensemble weights to minimize Brier score directly on calibrated probabilities rather than accuracy/AUC during cross-validation.
proposals.implementation: In GA mutate/crossover: change fitness function from accuracy to sklearn.metrics.brier_score_loss(). Weight XGBoost/CatBoost/LightGBM blend to minimize Brier on each CPCV split.
proposals.why: Study shows calibration-optimized models generate 69.86% higher returns than accuracy-optimized in sports betting.

proposals.title: Evolutionary Ensemble Weighting via Differential Evolution
proposals.technique: Use differential evolution to find optimal [w_xgb, w_cat, w_light, w_extra] blending weights that minimize Brier on validation fold. Repeat per CPCV split.
proposals.implementation: scipy.optimize.differential_evolution(brier_loss_fn, bounds=[(0,1)]*4, maxiter=100). Run once per generation in GA loop.
proposals.why: 4 models have different calibration profiles; evolution finds non-linear combinations humans miss.

proposals.title: Cross-Validated Purged Calibration (CPCV)
proposals.source: Purged CV methodology; combinatorial purged CV for financial ML
proposals.technique: Combinatorial purged cross-validation with embargo windows specific to NBA temporal structure. Calibrate isotonic map per fold on OOF predictions. Average maps across folds.
proposals.implementation: Implement PurgedKFold with embargo=7days (one week NBA gap). Fit isotonic calibration within each fold. Ensemble calibrated predictions.
proposals.why: NBA games have overlapping features (team stats, rest days); standard CV inflates reported Brier by not purging look-ahead bias.

proposals.title: Brier Score Decomposition Audit (misconceptions paper)
proposals.technique: Audit current Brier computation for common pitfalls: division by 2 for binary, class balance handling, calibration vs discrimination decomposition.
proposals.implementation: Review features/engine.py Brier computation. Verify: (1) using brier_score_loss not manual MSE, (2) correct handling of class imbalance, (3) separating reliability from resolution components.
proposals.why: If systematic bias exists in Brier computation (e.g., base rate shifts across seasons), fixing foundation before tuning is highest-ROI move.

recommended_order: Implement #1 (Isotonic CPCV) first — quickest 2-3% win. Then #2 (direct Brier in GA fitness). Then #3 (differential evolution weights).
deployment_note: All proposals are CPU-compatible (no GPU needed). Target S17 ensemble island as primary test bed (fleet best candidate).
